title: c5-triage-uncovered-branch output: one batched call's classifications
description: One call classifies every sampled uncovered branch within one enclosing method/class (docs/phase-c-acceptance.md, Step 5). Each entry doubles as one triage log entry.
$comment: maxItems is a hard cap, mirroring b3's 2-hop neighborhood cap. A method/class with more uncovered branches is pre-split by the orchestrator into multiple sub-batches before this step ever runs (steps/c5-triage-uncovered-branch.yaml) — never relaxed to fit a larger batch through in one call.

classification.description: not_sampled is never produced by this LLM step — it is written directly by the orchestrator for a risk_tier: sampled behavior's branches that fell outside the sampling rate. See docs/metrics.md #3.

justification.description: Required and non-boilerplate when classification is dead_code or unreachable_defensive.

suggested_scenario_summary.description: Required when classification == missing_scenario; routes back to c1/c2.

seed_data_strategy.description: Carried from Phase 0 so 'unreachable given this data' can be told apart from 'unreachable given any data'.

sample_rate.description: Only meaningful on not_sampled entries: the recorded per-application sampling rate in effect when this branch was excluded.
